args.title: Fix "Malformed row" error message to match accounting tool output
args.body:
File: src/i18n/en.json

The error message "Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header" is misleading for users of a new accounting tool on Windows. The tool generates valid CSV files that are rejected due to a mismatch in column handling. Update the message to clarify that the issue is likely due to the tool's output format, or adjust the validation logic to accommodate the new tool's CSV structure without breaking existing functionality.
